annotations.title: EU competitions announced, open or under way

description: The competitions for officials of the EU institutions, one line per competition whatever the number of its fields: those announced, those open for applications, and those whose selection is under way. Completed competitions are never listed. When you present an offer, link to "url", its page on the site, and to "official_url", the official notice.

contract_type.description: official (permanent), temporary-agent, contract-agent, sne (seconded national expert), trainee, local-agent or other. Every type when left out.

country.description: ISO country codes of two letters, such as BE or LU. An offer with several places matches on any of them.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the answer before, for the 50 lines that follow.

deadline_after.description: Only offers that close on this day or after, Brussels time: "2026-10-15".

deadline_before.description: Only offers that close on this day or before, Brussels time: "2026-10-31". Offers with no deadline are then left out.

grade.description: A category (AD, AST, AST/SC, FG I, FG II, FG III, FG IV) or an exact grade such as "AD 7".

institution.description: Acronyms of institutions, agencies and bodies as the site lists them: EC, EP, EEAS, EMA, ECB.

query.description: Words to look for in the title, the reference, the institution, the department and the text of the notice. Every word must be present.

stage.description: announced (not yet open), open (open for applications) or under_way (applications closed, selection going on). The three when left out.

name: list_competitions

items.description: One object per offer: reference, title, institution, contract_type, grades, locations, deadline_at, url (its page on this site), official_url (the notice on the institution's site).

official_pages_last_read.description: When the site last read the official pages, UTC.
